newsitem.title: USA: ANR sees Gulf gas output restored Fri/Sat.
newsitem.headline: ANR sees Gulf gas output restored Fri/Sat.

text.p: ANR Pipeline said Thursday it will likely restore by Friday or Saturday the 400 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of gas shut in as a result of cold weather.

"We should have most or all of it back by Friday or Saturday. We lost about 400 million on both our Southwest and Southeast legs, but we're having no problems delivering to customers," a company spokesman said.
He noted that ANR was withdrawing gas from storage to make up for the lost production.
The Southwest leg, with a total capacity of about 725 mmcfd, runs through Oklahoma and the Texas Panhandle.
The Southeast leg, with a capacity of about 1.3 billion cubic feet per day, runs offshore Texas to onshore Louisiana.
ANR Pipeline is a unit of Coastal Corp.
